scope: Read-only native SAM2 CPU FP32 attention; commit this protocol and tested sources before the new seq2/seq3 gate. Historical results and the ongoing geometry audit are not altered.
definitions: Unchanged primary mixed cells, author incoherence, amended trimaps 15/21/29, inner-band 0.02; old trimaps 3/7 retained as diagnostics outside the amended claim rule. Amendment remains exploratory as previously disclosed.
query_labels: Fixed GT-reference primary mixed-cell labels on native 64x64 query grid for the current target. Analysis-only labels; never model inputs, memory writes or steering. Query grouping remains fixed when comparing memory definitions. Future arbitrary query regrouping is NOT possible from these aggregates.
memory_labels: Each spatial key is tied by raw-feature identity to its own stored prediction; row-major memory64 labels for every retained definition. Prompt memory is the single GT initialization. Pointers are separate and retain their native attention.

logging.array: FP32 compressed joint_mass[3,K] = sum of native author attention over heads and query positions in group / (heads * all_query_count). Include spatial and pointer keys; save group query counts, memory-frame order, pointer count, query count and layer.
logging.normalization: Joint array sums to one. Each group sums to its fraction of queries. Conditional key mass is joint row * all_query_count / group_query_count; undefined for empty query groups. Check saved precision as well as author reconstruction.
logging.precision: Float32 storage, no FP16 quantization; absolute mass tolerance 1e-4; author-output reconstruction atol1e-4/rtol1e-3. Native logits must be bit-identical in a fresh no-observer replay.
logging.reuse: Any new memory-region grouping or memory signed-distance curve can be computed from these key masses and saved native masks without inference. Cannot recover individual-query maps or gradients.
logging.storage: Drive-mounted outputs/caches and mandatory online W&B. Measure compressed bytes on gate; report projected full-cohort size rather than promise 1GB. Per-sequence archives include every token file.

summary.unit: Sequence, never frame/read/token. Report per layer and pooled across four layers, separately for each fixed query region and all queries.
summary.pooled_ratio: Within each sequence/stratum/layer/query group: M_r=sum joint mass on region r; M_s=sum joint mass on all spatial keys; T_r=sum query_fraction * region_key_count/spatial_key_count; T_s=sum query_fraction. Enrichment=(M_r/M_s)/(T_r/T_s). Pool sums BEFORE dividing; do not average per-read ratios. Pointer mass is reported separately.
summary.across_sequences: Report each sequence's pooled enrichment, median natural-log enrichment and exp(median log enrichment). Positive finite sequence estimates receive equal weight. Zero enrichment has log=-infinity and is reported, not replaced by an epsilon; empty-group/zero-denominator estimates are undefined and excluded with explicit N. If nonfinite logs occur, report the extended median and omit CI with explanation.
summary.uncertainty: For finite log estimates, 10000 whole-sequence bootstrap resamples, seed20261023, percentile95 CI for median log enrichment. No confirmatory hypothesis tests or selective layer/width reporting. Patient independence is unverified.
summary.size: Per-target original GT area fraction. Frozen quartiles from all1710 positive source frames: [0.020346832275390626,0.053846345464355336,0.11534966362847222]. Ties lower; absent separate. Report overall and each size bin; query-empty or memory-region-empty counts accompany estimates.
summary.success_failure: No Dice cutoff is chosen. GT-positive targets with zero predicted/GT intersection are complete misses; GT-positive targets with nonzero intersection are overlap-present, not necessarily accurate segmentations. GT-absent targets are separately correct-empty or false-positive. Report these strata and their continuous Dice distributions; do not call overlap-present a validated clinical success.
summary.claim_rule: Keep the amended exploratory cross-definition rule; k3/k7 diagnostic-only. Attention allocation is not causal utility. Do not change definitions, strata or summary based on result direction. Unexpected results are recorded.

footprint_precision: Alongside existing contour coverage, report (one-pixel native256 contour pixels inside boundary-token footprints)/(pixels covered by boundary-token footprints), including/excluding outer raster border. Use the same unchanged author BoundaryIoU contour. This is footprint precision, not conventional tolerance-based boundary-F precision; report numerators/denominators. Zero support gives undefined precision. Self and GT references separate.
gate: Complete seq2/seq3 with all four layers, query/key alignment, per-group and total mass checks, prompt/writer checks, frozen parameters, bit-exact fresh no-observer replay, source/checkpoint/device/protocol matching, confirmed W&B delivery. Only then full seq1–23; unpromptable/reference-only frames never get fabricated attention.
stopping_rule: Fail closed on failed integrity/replay/mass/storage/delivery checks; record a dated corrective commit and rerun the matching gate. Never change code because a scientific result is unexpected.
next_stage: After attention is summarized using this committed method, write/test/commit the exact contiguity-matched exclusion protocol before launching CPU FP32 exclusions. Until that receipt exists, no exclusion launch; count-only historical controls are insufficient.
